Gondian Pippin Bow is a rock gnome member of the Church of Gond who can be found in the Steel Watch Foundry during Act Three.
“
You've got more courage than half this city combined.
„
— Pippin Bow

Involvement

Act Three

Pippin Bow can be encountered together with  Zanner Toobin and other Gondians at the Foundry. He and  Lilly Tilly only appear if two or more Gondians are killed during the party's first visit to the Foundry, the  Motivator did not go off, and the party comes back to the Foundry after visiting the Iron Throne.
